profile.summary: Kaiser Foundation Health Plan, Inc. and Kaiser Foundation Hospitals are the health plan and hospital entities of Kaiser Permanente, an integrated nonprofit organization that provides health care and health coverage to members in California and several other states. Kaiser Permanente is headquartered in Oakland, California.

review.notes: Kaiser's fast-facts page names Kaiser Foundation Health Plan, Inc. and Kaiser Foundation Hospitals as components of Kaiser Permanente, a not-for-profit headquartered in Oakland; the who-we-are page describes it as an integrated nonprofit care and coverage organization.
